title: Khudaya Mujhe
body:
Khudaya mujhe
<<MINI>>
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade..(2)
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe..(2)
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheedane karbobala se mila de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khudaya mujhe ilm o hikmat ata ho
khudaya mujhe unki nusrat ata ho
khudaya mujhe bhi shahadat ata ho..(2)
lahu raahe haq me bahana sikha de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
2. meri maa ne saqqa banaya hai mujhko
tarika aza ka bataya hai mujhko
ghume sheh me rona sikhaya hai mujhko..(2)
meri maa ki mehnat ka itna sila de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
3. meri rozi halalat ki karke dikhau
mai bacho ko nusrat ki rahe batau
imame zamana ke qabil banau..(2)
jo rehbar ka rasta hai uspar chala de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Zahoor unka hoga to maida sajega
namazi azadaar hi saath dega
<<MINI>>
imam e zamana ka lashkar banega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khwabo me hai bus wo manzar dikha de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dua hai musibat ko zainab ki samjhu ke labbaik kehkar qadam me badhau
hifazat ko roze ki mai shaam jau..(2)
mai pohchu to zainab ki maa ye dua de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Musalsal hai ankhe bighoti sakina
hai darr, siskiyo se hai roti sakina
zamee par hai zinda ke soti sakina..(2) ke us qaid khane se usko chuda de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai shabbir ab mere maula ye mahdi
na ab mere maula ho teero se zakhmi
na akbar ke seene pe lag jae barchi..(2)
ladu mai yazeedo se ye hausla de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
Imam e zamana ka nasir banade
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Saro par rahe meri behno ke chadar
bane jab imame zamana ka lashkar to ho nasiro me qamar aur safdar..(2)
har ehle aza bas yehi ek dua de
<<MINI>>
khudaya mujhe, khudaya mujhe
